verdict.rationale: Aircall is a cloud telephony SaaS with a public API, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only the REST API, OAuth and Basic Auth tutorials, webhooks, and product features, with no mention of an official command-line tool. Public API endpoints are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
